    Bridge to general Auslander--Reiten theory #

    General Auslander--Reiten theory works with finitely generated right modules FGModuleCat Aᵐᵒᵖ and with the radical of that whole category. This file connects it with the objects of RepresentationType/Basic/RightModules.lean:

    • an IndSkeleton is a FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton;

    • ind(mod A) embeds fully faithfully into mod A = FGModuleCat Aᵐᵒᵖ;

    • the radical morphisms of ind(mod A) are the general radical morphisms;

    • J²(X, Y), defined through indecomposable intermediate objects, is the general radical square, defined through arbitrary finitely generated intermediate modules;

    • hence Irr(X, Y) is linearly isomorphic to the general irreducible space.

    • an IndSkeleton is a FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton;

    • ind(mod A) embeds fully faithfully into mod A = FGModuleCat Aᵐᵒᵖ;

    • the radical morphisms of ind(mod A) are the radical morphisms;

    • J²(X, Y), defined through indecomposable intermediate objects, is the radical square, defined through arbitrary finitely generated intermediate modules;

    • hence Irr(X, Y) is linearly isomorphic to the irreducible space.
